title: Lower moment bound by degree
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a real-valued function on the uniform Boolean cube, and let $k\in\mathbb N$. Suppose every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is supported on a set of size at most $k$. For real numbers $p,q$ with $0<p<2<q$, the norms defined by $\|f\|_r=(\E|f|^r)^{1/r}$ satisfy $\|f\|_2\le \exp\!\left(\dfrac{kq(2-p)}{2p}\right)\|f\|_p$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube of Fourier degree at most $k\in\mathbb N$, and let $0<p<2<q$. Then $\|f\|_2\le\exp(kq(2-p)/(2p))\|f\|_p$.
